item.title: Over 2,000 People Killed In Iran Protests: Official
item.description: Iran has acknowledged for the first time that the death toll from its ongoing nationwide protests has reached a staggering figure, with an Iranian official telling Reuters that around 2,000 people, including members of the security forces, have been killed over the past two weeks. The admission marks the most serious official confirmation yet of the scale of violence unleashed during one of the most intense internal crises the Islamic Republic has faced in years.

item.title: Trump Bristles as Greenland Rules Out US, Reaffirms Ties with Denmark
item.description: Greenland has firmly rejected any notion of joining the United States, pushing back against renewed annexation rhetoric from US President Donald Trump and reaffirming its place within the Kingdom of Denmark amid rising geopolitical tensions in the Arctic.

item.title: Pentagon Moves USS Abraham Lincoln Strike Group to Middle East
item.description: The United States has begun redeploying a major naval force from the Indo-Pacific to the Middle East as tensions rise sharply between Washington and Tehran amid widespread unrest inside Iran. The US Defence Headquarters, the Pentagon, has confirmed that a carrier strike group is being moved from the South China Sea to the area of responsibility of US Central Command (CENTCOM), which covers the Middle East.

item.title: BJP-Led Alliance Poised to Capture BMC as Thackerays Slip
item.description: Polling was held for 2,869 seats across 893 wards, with a turnout of 52.94 percent. The results underscore a major political realignment in Maharashtra’s urban landscape.

item.title: Trump Drops Tariff Warning to European Allies Over Greenland Dispute
item.description: President Donald Trump on Wednesday stunned allies by abruptly canceling his proposed tariff measures against European partners, signalling a tactical retreat after he and NATO’s leadership agreed on what was described as a “framework of a future deal” on Arctic security. item.title: India Beats NZ in Second T20 Match
item.description: Suryakumar Yadav has slammed his long-awaited fifty as India are closing in on a win against New Zealand in the second T20I in Raipur tonight. Ishan Kishan fell for 76 off 32 balls. Earlier, the Black Caps scored 208 for six after being invited to bat first. New Zealand relied on a blistering 26-ball 44 from Rachin Ravindra and brisk cameos from the other top-order batters to get off to a flying start. item.title: Ajit Pawar Dies in Tragic Plane Crash
item.description: Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister and Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) leader Ajit Pawar has died in a devastating plane crash on the morning of January 28, 2026. The aircraft, a Learjet 45XR (registration VT-SSK) operated by VSR Ventures, was en route from Mumbai to Baramati for a series of scheduled public meetings ahead of the local body elections when it came down near Baramati airport while attempting to land.

item.title: Union Budget 2026 is poised to mark a decisive break from a 75-year-old convention
item.description: For the first time, Part B of the Budget—traditionally reserved for tax proposals and policy fine print—is likely to take centre stage, laying out a comprehensive vision for India’s economic trajectory, according to sources.

item.title: No Big Bang, Just Balance: A Realist Union Budget
item.description: In her ninth consecutive budget, which includes an interim one, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman combined a grand futuristic vision with micro-technical tinkering, partly shied away from big-ticket reforms and immediate radical changes, and did not focus too much on the financial numbers that seemed weak and unstable.
